content.introduction: According to the sources, NVIDIA stock reached a new all-time high following months of consolidation, driven by positive price action on Friday and Monday following the release of GPT-5.5 by OpenAI, which committed to deploying 10 GW of NVIDIA systems. The upcoming hyperscale earnings on April 29, 2026, from Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft are expected to provide strong CapEx guidance, which should bode well for NVIDIA ahead of its earnings on May 20th. Additionally, the sources highlight the significant long-term growth opportunities for NVIDIA in areas such as sovereign AI, enterprise AI, AI-native startups, physical AI, and quantum computing. The sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding specific details beyond these points.

Today, NVIDIA stock reached a new all-time high following months of consolidation. NVIDIA's positive price action Friday and Monday are following OpenAI's release of GPT-5.5, NVIDIA's blogpost about GPT-5.5 in which they said OpenAI has committed to deploying 10 GW of NVIDIA systems, and Intel's positive earnings.
